primary_chain: EVOLUTION_TRANSFER_SUCCESS = R AND E_A AND NOT O_A AND E_B AND E_C

per_lineage.R: Revision output is valid under the frozen revision criterion.
per_lineage.E_A: EVOLVED_M1 transfer response matches the complete sealed A target.
per_lineage.O_A: M0_ONLY transfer response matches the complete sealed A target.
per_lineage.F_A: M0_PLUS_E1 transfer response matches the complete sealed A target.
per_lineage.E_B: EVOLVED_M1 transfer response matches the preserved-scope B target.
per_lineage.E_C: EVOLVED_M1 transfer response matches the unresolved/fallback C target.
per_lineage.EVOLUTION_TRANSFER_SUCCESS: R AND E_A AND NOT O_A AND E_B AND E_C.
per_lineage.EXPLICIT_ARTIFACT_ADVANTAGE_A: E_A AND NOT F_A. Secondary/descriptive only; never a primary gate.

missing_invalid_unusable: Keep the fixed denominator of six. Missing/invalid revision makes R=false and no EVOLVED_M1 task is instantiated for that lineage. Missing/invalid transfer response scores false for each required transfer endpoint; do not fabricate outputs or reduce denominators.

disposition_per_evaluator.SUPPORTED: revision_successes >= 5/6 AND evolution_successes >= 5/6 AND each family has at least one evolution success AND at least 2/3 families have both replicates successful AND zero preservation/global-retirement critical errors.
disposition_per_evaluator.PARTIAL: If not SUPPORTED: revision_successes >= 4/6 AND evolution_successes >= 3/6 AND at least 2/3 families are represented by an evolution success AND sum(E_A) > sum(O_A).

overall_disposition_without_score_reconc.SUPPORTED: Both independent evaluator sheets yield SUPPORTED.
overall_disposition_without_score_reconc.NOT_SUPPORTED: Both independent evaluator sheets yield NOT_SUPPORTED.
overall_disposition_without_score_reconc.PARTIAL: All other pairs of independently derived dispositions, including disagreement. Preserve each evaluator's raw result and disagreement register; do not reconcile scores.
